title: Monorail passengers on the approved crowd bodies
caption: The man with a book, the girl with headphones and the woman with a bun now use the approved office bodies A and B, seated on the near benches instead of in the doorways.

sections.title: Day 1 on the train
sections.caption: The car as the day starts, and the arrival at Honsha, on desktop and phone.

sections.title: Close-ups
sections.caption: Each passenger from the aisle. The book and phones sit in their hands and the headphones on her head. The bodies wear a smaller copy of their skin on the train to keep it inside its texture budget.

sections.title: Their small moments still work
sections.caption: The video on her phone, the printout beside his book and the shopping bag, run through the real interaction.

sections.title: Before
sections.caption: The code-built placeholders, two of them sitting in the doorways past the shortened benches.
